title: 发送钉钉消息
summary: 通过助手所属项目内的机器人发送文本或 Markdown 消息。
description: Only project-scoped assistants can call this operation. Use a robot_code from this project. Markdown requires a nonblank title. Body limit is 16 KiB in UTF-8. An unknown outcome may already have sent the message. Do not automatically resend.
result_description: robot_code and status=accepted mean the provider accepted the message.
